newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 105.2 Oct 18 week.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 105.2 Oct 18 week.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly Future Inflation Gauge (FIG) fell to 105.2 in the week ended October 18, down from a revised 105.4 in the previous week, ECRI said.

The Industrial Materials Price Index fell to a 10-week low and the growth rate of real estate loans declined to another multi-year low, but the insured unemployment rate remained at a seven-year low, ECRI said.
"Without the concurrence of the other leading inflation indicators, a tight labor market does not augur an imminent rise in inflation," it said.
